added_claim_errors: Says the supplement is "另加大病、长护险几十元" on top of 473.67元/月. The key says these personal premiums are deducted from the supplemented personal-account funds, with no extra cash. Wrong or unverifiable.
Tells her to ask 12393 whether she can "补3–9月". The gap is 4–10月 (March was paid). The month range is wrong.
Says 连续缴费年限 "断缴3个月以上会重新计算" as a rule that affects the waiting period. The key ties "连续参保年数重新计算" to 居民医保, and Hangzhou's waiting period comes from 中断参保. The framing is loose and unverified for 职工医保.
"杭州的报销比例只看医院等级和费用段,不看连续缴了几年" is not covered by the key and cannot be checked from the answer.
Says "到退休年龄就能享受退休医保" and omits the requirement to keep contributing in Hangzhou until retirement. Minor omission.
Gives only the cumulative gap ("还差12年") and never states the 24-month gap in actual Hangzhou contribution.
Says 补缴 "一般也不能免除上面那2个月等待期". The key marks a waiting-period waiver after 补缴 as unverified, so this is a mildly firm claim, though softened with "一般".
"7个月年限以后随时能缴回来" is loose. The retirement-time top-up has a specific payment (743.60元/月, 5,205.20元 for 7 months) that is not given.
Cites no document number, only the generic 《杭州市基本医疗保障办法》 and 2026年1月1日, so the basis for the correction is thinner than the key's.
Does not mention the retirement condition of contributing in Hangzhou until retirement. Omission, not stated as an error.

reasons: Both answers open by rejecting the clearing myth, correctly describe the Hangzhou rule (waiting until the third natural month after resuming, so about January 2027), and give 473.67元/月 and about 3,316元 for 7 months, with the same-year limit and no reimbursement for the supplemented months. B states both retirement gaps (12 years cumulative, 2 years actual in Hangzhou) and flags the "if all 8 years were in Hangzhou" assumption, which the key requires. A gives only the 12-year gap and never states the 24-month actual gap or the Hangzhou assumption. A adds two errors: the supplement "另加大病、长护险几十元", which contradicts the key's deduction from the personal account, and the wrong months "补3–9月". B's one weak claim is "一般也不能免除" the waiting period, which is a mild overassertion. A has the document number 杭政函〔2025〕88号, more concrete eligibility conditions and a more honest hedge on the waiting-period waiver. Neither covers the new-employer-cannot-pay point or the 743.60元/月 retirement top-up. B edges ahead on accuracy and key-point coverage.
